# Cleaning Demo (Sweden Sample)

Our variables of interest are:
WB_TODAY
WB_FIVEYRS
PHYSICAL_HLTH
EXPECT_GOOD
GENDER (1 male, 2 female)
INCOME FEELINGS
AGE
EXTRAVERSION: TRAITS1 and TRAITS6
NEUROTICISM: TRAITS4 and TRAITS9
CONSCIENTIOUSNESS: TRAITS3 and TRAITS8
COUNTRY

```{r}
myDemo_sub <- myDemo %>%
  select(COUNTRY,
         WB_TODAY,
         WB_FIVEYRS,
         PHYSICAL_HLTH,
         EXPECT_GOOD,
         GENDER,
         INCOME_FEELINGS,
         AGE,
         TRAITS1, TRAITS6, # extraversion
         TRAITS4, TRAITS9, # neuroticism
         TRAITS3, TRAITS8) # conscientiousness

dim(myDemo_sub)
glimpse(myDemo_sub)
```

```{r}
# recode nonsubstantive responses to NA
recode_missing <- function(x, codes = c(-98, 98, 99)) {
  x <- zap_labels(x)
  x[x %in% codes] <- NA
  x
}

myDemo_clean <- myDemo_sub %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(WB_TODAY, WB_FIVEYRS, PHYSICAL_HLTH, EXPECT_GOOD,
             GENDER, starts_with("TRAITS")),
           recode_missing),
    INCOME_FEELINGS = recode_missing(INCOME_FEELINGS, c(-98, 5, 6)),
    AGE             = recode_missing(AGE, c(-98, 100, 101)),
    COUNTRY         = zap_labels(COUNTRY)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(WB_TODAY, WB_FIVEYRS, PHYSICAL_HLTH, EXPECT_GOOD),
           ~ if_else(between(.x, 0, 10), .x, NA)),
    across(starts_with("TRAITS"), ~ if_else(between(.x, 1, 7), .x, NA)),
    INCOME_FEELINGS = if_else(between(INCOME_FEELINGS, 1, 4), INCOME_FEELINGS, NA),
    AGE = if_else(between(AGE, 18, 99), AGE, NA)
  ) %>%
  filter(GENDER %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  mutate(FEMALE = as.integer(GENDER == 2))
```

# Reverse Coding

```{r}
myDemo_clean <- myDemo_clean %>%
  mutate(
    SUBJECTIVE_INCOME = 5 - INCOME_FEELINGS,# higher = better
    TRAITS1_r = 8 - TRAITS1, # extraverted, enthusiastic
    TRAITS4_r = 8 - TRAITS4, # anxious, easily upset
    TRAITS3_r = 8 - TRAITS3  # dependable, self-disciplined
  )

count(myDemo_clean, INCOME_FEELINGS, SUBJECTIVE_INCOME)
count(myDemo_clean, TRAITS1, TRAITS1_r)
count(myDemo_clean, TRAITS4, TRAITS4_r)
count(myDemo_clean, TRAITS3, TRAITS3_r)
```

# Scale/Index
```{r}

#TIPI scale construction (higher = more of the trait)
myDemo_clean <- myDemo_clean %>%
  mutate(
    EXTRAVERSION      = (TRAITS1_r + TRAITS6) / 2,   # extraverted (r) + reserved
    NEUROTICISM       = (TRAITS4_r + TRAITS9) / 2,   # anxious (r) + calm
    CONSCIENTIOUSNESS = (TRAITS3_r + TRAITS8) / 2    # dependable (r) + disorganized
  )
```

```{r}
myDemo_clean %>%
  select(EXTRAVERSION, NEUROTICISM, CONSCIENTIOUSNESS) %>%
  summary()

# Scale missingness
myDemo_clean %>%
  summarise(across(c(EXTRAVERSION, NEUROTICISM, CONSCIENTIOUSNESS),
                   ~ round(mean(is.na(.x)), 3)))

# Inter-item correlations
myDemo_clean %>%
  summarise(
    r_extraversion      = cor(TRAITS1_r, TRAITS6, use = "complete.obs"),
    r_neuroticism       = cor(TRAITS4_r, TRAITS9, use = "complete.obs"),
    r_conscientiousness = cor(TRAITS3_r, TRAITS8, use = "complete.obs")
  )
```
# Centering
```{r}
# grand-mean centering (single-country models)
center <- function(x) x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)

myDemo_clean <- myDemo_clean %>%
  mutate(
    AGE_c               = center(AGE),
    PHYSICAL_HLTH_c     = center(PHYSICAL_HLTH),
    SUBJECTIVE_INCOME_c = center(SUBJECTIVE_INCOME),
    EXPECT_GOOD_c       = center(EXPECT_GOOD),
    EXTRAVERSION_c      = center(EXTRAVERSION),
    NEUROTICISM_c       = center(NEUROTICISM),
    CONSCIENTIOUSNESS_c = center(CONSCIENTIOUSNESS)
  ) %>%
  # derived terms from centered variables
  mutate(
    AGE_c2          = AGE_c^2,
    SRH_x_AGE       = PHYSICAL_HLTH_c * AGE_c
  )

# note, if lavaan can't estimate with age as continuous will use age in decades, centered
#AGE_c   = center(AGE) / 10,   
#AGE_c2  = AGE_c^2,
#SRH_x_AGE = PHYSICAL_HLTH_c * AGE_c

```

```{r}
# centering verification
myDemo_clean %>%
  summarise(across(ends_with("_c"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  round(10)

sd(myDemo_clean$AGE, na.rm = TRUE); sd(myDemo_clean$AGE_c, na.rm = TRUE)

# save RDS
saveRDS(myDemo_clean, "gfs_clean_perturbed.RDS")
```

# Age group construction for multigroup RI-CLPM

```{r}
myDemo_clean <- myDemo_clean %>%
  mutate(
    AGE_GROUP = case_when(
      AGE >= 18 & AGE <= 44 ~ "Young (18-44)",
      AGE >= 45 & AGE <= 64 ~ "Middle (45-64)",
      AGE >= 65             ~ "Older (65+)"
    ),
    AGE_GROUP = factor(AGE_GROUP,
                       levels = c("Young (18-44)", "Middle (45-64)", "Older (65+)"))
  )

count(myDemo_clean, AGE_GROUP)

myDemo_clean %>%
  group_by(AGE_GROUP) %>%
  summarise(min_age = min(AGE), max_age = max(AGE), n = n())

saveRDS(myDemo_clean, "gfs_clean_perturbed.RDS")
```
